title: General Organa Receives Bad News
description: At the Resistance base, General Leia Organa is waiting for any information about the missing map. A young officer named Brance delivers the update on the First Order's destruction of Tuanul village, explaining, "General, the Jakku village was wiped out. Lor San Tekka was killed." Brance goes on to say that Poe was missing and there was no word from BB-8. "Never underestimate a Droid," Leia reminds Brance before he walks away.
